visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a white, rectangular electronic device with a translucent cap, held by a hand. Bold red and yellow text overlays the center of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit retail store interior with shelves of packaged lifestyle products. A hand wearing a white smartwatch reaches for a device. (3) A medium shot shows a young man in a black jacket and a striped shirt talking to a woman whose back is to the camera; he holds a coffee cup in his left hand and gestures with his right. (4) Close-up of the man's face as he speaks with animated expressions and points toward the device. (5) The woman holding the device rotates it, showing a USB-C charging port and a small rotating blade head underneath the cap. (6) The man gestures toward his underarm and later his nose while laughing. (7) A second woman in a black bucket hat enters the frame and looks at the device with curiosity. (8) Transition to a black screen with white text. (9) Indoor home setting, close-up of a person's hands using the device's rotating trimmer on a fingernail. (10) The camera shows a different side of the device where a grey grinding head is used on the edge of the nail, with a computer monitor visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo pop music begins with electronic synthesizers. A female voice speaks with high energy and a friendly tone. (2) A male voice interjects, guessing excitedly with a rising pitch. The background chatter of the store is faintly audible. (3) A distinct mechanical whirring sound (high-frequency motor) starts as the device is activated. (4) Sound of multiple people laughing and overlapping dialogue creates a chaotic but joyful atmosphere. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a scene transition. (6) The mechanical sound changes to a lower-frequency grinding texture as the nail tool is used. Music continues until the end.
